title: AnchorRep: Defending LLMs Against Cross-Model Adversarial Transfer via Representation Repulsion
abstract: arXiv:2609.32602v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adversarial attacks optimized on a single open-weight LLM can transfer to and jailbreak architecturally different models, allowing an attacker with white-box access to one model to compromise independently deployed systems. This creates a shared vulnerability across models, yet existing defenses are not designed for this cross-model threat. We find that cross-model transfer aligns with shared internal representation geometry, making it a natural defense target. AnchorRep targets this geometry directly with a lightweight LoRA adapter that pushes the defended model's internal representations of harmful prompts away from those of a frozen anchor model on the same prompts. Training uses a small set of harmful prompts and no adversarial examples. Across five models and four architectural families, AnchorRep reduces cross-model attack success rate to <=1.1% on 2,000 transferred attacks (0% on two), including the largest drop on Mistr

translated_title: AnchorRep：通过表示排斥防御大语言模型的跨模型对抗迁移攻击
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.32602v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在单个开源权重大语言模型上优化的对抗攻击可以迁移并越狱架构不同的模型，这使得拥有对一个模型白盒访问权限的攻击者能够攻陷独立部署的其他系统。这在模型之间造成了共享的漏洞，然而现有的防御方法并非针对这种跨模型威胁而设计。我们发现跨模型迁移攻击与共享的内部表示几何结构相关，这使其成为一个天然的防御目标。AnchorRep通过一个轻量级的LoRA适配器直接针对这种几何结构进行防御，将被防御模型对有害提示词的内部表示推离冻结的锚点模型对相同提示词的内部表示。训练过程仅使用少量有害提示词，无需任何对抗样本。在五个模型和四种架构家族上的实验表明，AnchorRep将2,000次迁移攻击的跨模型攻击成功率降低至≤1.1%（其中两个模型上为0%），包括在Mistr……（摘要截断于此）
tldr: 提出AnchorRep防御方法，利用轻量级LoRA适配器将有害提示词的内部表示与锚点模型的表示相排斥，无需对抗样本即可将跨模型对抗迁移攻击的成功率降低至1.1%以下。
en_tdlr: AnchorRep defends LLMs against cross-model adversarial transfer attacks by using a lightweight LoRA adapter to repel internal representations of harmful prompts away from a frozen anchor model, reducing attack success rate to ≤1.1% without requiring any adversarial examples.
